SELECT p.ProductName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity) AS revenue
FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID
GROUP BY p.ProductName

-- Sales credited to the employee who took the order
SELECT e.LastName, COUNT(DISTINCT o.OrderID) AS orders_taken
FROM Orders o JOIN Employees e ON o.EmployeeID = e.EmployeeID
WHERE o.OrderDate >= '1997-01-01'
GROUP BY e.LastName

-- Net revenue = price x quantity after discount (finance-approved definition)
SELECT c.CategoryName, SUM(od.UnitPrice * od.Quantity * (1 - od.Discount)) AS net_revenue
FROM "Order Details" od JOIN Products p ON od.ProductID = p.ProductID
JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID = c.CategoryID
GROUP BY c.CategoryName
